exact_result: Unverified partial reconstruction of the genuine singular mixed finite-energy operator and its conditional equation theory, rational local metric/product bridges, smooth weak upper-growth affine regularization/removal, and open determinant trace. Original singular/geometrically unibranch existence is not proved.
concrete_gaps: Wu 6.15 full weak split-piece application: a global witness, compact support and winning-collar control, and an integer-trace localization preserving the later hull argument are not proved; gamma=1 requires a separate estimate.
Complete real-support barrier/localization, weak Hartogs Runge proof, finite local-projection geometry and singular-stratum induction in Wu 6.3–6.5 and 6.7–6.16 remain unconstructed.
Countable rational singular EP is unresolved: actual Wu 7.1 LF2716–2717 invokes the unreconstructed weak/global Theorem 6.5.
Arbitrary-cardinality and ample-real-class EP, onto normalization, singular unbounded envelope differentiation and unconditional variational attainment remain conditional on that singular EP base.
